 "content": "def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    # Separator rows/columns are the full lines of color 3; summarize each
    # enclosed block by the number of 5 cells, marking the densest block(s).
    sep_r = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == 3]
    sep_c = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == 3 for row in grid)]
    bounds_r = [-1] + sep_r + [n]
    bounds_c = [-1] + sep_c + [len(grid[0])]
    counts = []
    for i in range(len(bounds_r)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(bounds_c)-1):
            row.append(sum(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(bounds_r[i]+1, bounds_r[i+1]) for c in range(bounds_c[j]+1, bounds_c[j+1])))
        counts.append(row)
    best = max(max(row) for row in counts)
    return [[1 if x == best and x > 0 else 3 for x in row] for row in counts]

    # Partition by full separator rows/columns; each cell block becomes its
    # most frequent original color, except count anomalies encoded as 1.
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(R) if all(v==grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and grid[r][0] not in (0,)]
    sc=[c for c in range(C) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[0][c] for r in range(R)) and grid[0][c] not in (0,)]
    # Actual separator colors inferred as lines of 3 or 9.
    sr=[r for r in range(R) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and grid[r][0] in (3,9)]
    sc=[c for c in range(C) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(R)})==1 and grid[0][c] in (3,9)]
    rb=[-1]+sr+[R]; cb=[-1]+sc+[C]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i]+1,rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1,cb[j+1])]
            # Count cells differing from the dominant background; 1 denotes
            # blocks with a 9-marker, while ordinary blocks retain background.
            bg=max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
            row.append(1 if any(v==9 for v in vals) else bg)
        out.append(row)

def transform(grid):
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_r = [r for r in range(R) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_c = [c for c in range(C) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(R)}) == 1]
    rb, cb = [-1] + sep_r + [R], [-1] + sep_c + [C]
    result = []
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])]
            counts = Counter(vals)
            background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            # A tile with at least two cells of its non-background color is flagged.
            row.append(1 if any(n >= 2 for color, n in counts.items() if color != background) else background)
        result.append(row)
